problems: Cliopatria folds the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg into the Netherlands shapes 1815-1829 and 1840-1916 (wrong from 1890); the netherlands dossier removes it and draws a personal-union tint with counterpart 'luxembourg', so the luxembourg dossier must cover 1815-1890 or a separate Grand Duchy dossier is needed.

Cliopatria's Nazi Germany shapes 1940-1944 contain 155 of 157 Netherlands cells; the netherlands dossier adds an occupation keyframe 1940-1944 (not annexed). The eu-21 nazi-germany dossier should draw it as occupied.
principality-of-andorra and eu-12-b's co-principality-of-andorra are one state broken by the 1812-1813 annexation; the orchestrator should merge or share one colour.
Cliopatria's Italian Nationalists row (1848) is Sicily and ends in 1848 while the revolt lasted to 15 May 1849; the Kingdom of Sardinia row, not the Two Sicilies, holds Sicily and Calabria from 1860.
Cliopatria's Kingdom of Prussia row ends in 1863, so the 1866 annexation of Frankfurt has no matching Prussian shape.
principality-of-lichtenberg: Cliopatria's 179 km2 cell omits the capital and ends in 1827 (page: 1816-1834, 537 km2); corrected in the dossier.

Several start/end years differ from Cliopatria's by design: Two Sicilies 1815-1861 (rump keyframe 1861), Andorra from 1814, Sweden-Norway from November 1814 to 26 October 1905, Frankfurt 1815-1866, Lichtenberg 1816-1834; each has new keyframes.
